attchmntText: Ansal Properties & Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Delay in declaration of Un-Audited Financial Results for the 02nd Quarter/Half Year ended on the 30th September, 2026 of Financial year 2026-27 beyond the time frame stipulated under Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended.
desc: Reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results
voiceSummary: Ansal Properties and Infrastructure Limited has informed the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited of a delay in finalizing, approving, and declaring its Un-Audited Financial Results for the 02nd Quarter and Half Year ended on the 30th September, 2026, of Financial Year 2026-27. The results were due by the 14th November, 2026. The delay is attributed to the ongoing process of finalizing the Un-Audited Financial Results for the 01st Quarter ended on the 30th June, 2026, which was also delayed and previously reported on the 10th August, 2026. The Company states it is making all possible efforts to declare the results at the earliest. The Trading Window remains closed until 48 hours after the approval and declaration of the Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter ended on the 30th September, 2026. The letter was signed by Siddharth Goenka, Whole Time Director, with DIN 11524566.
